header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
body: None appeared on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation received. Same was the position on last date of hearing.
Perusal of the prayer clause reveals that petitioner is seeking directions to the respondents for the distribution of books to the students of government schools in Mirpurkhas Division.
In view of the prayer clause sought, this petition is disposed of with directions to the respondents to act strictly in accordance with law and according to their policies. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
